name: exit_budget_repair
discovery: All 75 existing primary historical accounts were inspected. The 22 captured failures are sell-budget conflicts; their returns are already known. This is reused research evidence, not an independent test.
change: Run the original LP first. Only for solver status 2 with an existing sell budget, remove just that sell-budget inequality and minimize total sales while retaining all other constraints. If feasible and minimum sales exceed the original budget, raise that budget only to the minimum plus 1e-9 numerical weight tolerance, then optimize the unchanged economic objective. Keep the buy budget, all hard constraints, all realized fees and default reduce-only handling when hard constraints remain infeasible. Never relax for solver timeout, unboundedness or numerical error.
candidate_budget: Exactly one deterministic correction; no alternative policy, threshold, penalty or parameter search in this protocol. Earlier bounded strategy_study remains closed.

fixed_forecast_stage.scope: Use the original frozen forecasts and rule schedule for legacy and exit_priority; 150 accounts per arm. Require exact legacy summary and complete-ledger parity. Save candidate ledgers, independent audits and first economic differences.

retraining_stage.scope: Re-run the same feature, label, model, calibration and inner candidate definitions. Only the exit_priority arm uses the correction during inner rule/model selection and outer evaluation. Baseline evaluates all 19 existing policies; repaired arm evaluates selected_strategy and matched_momentum. Compare estimator files and all prediction arrays, and attribute reselected rules/models separately from fixed-forecast effects.

activation: Candidate may become active only after solver/causality/accounting checks pass, original model and full baseline parity pass, and reselected primary continuous net return is no lower at each of 10/20/30bp with observed maximum drawdown no greater than 8%. If any gate fails, preserve the current legacy policy and report the failure. This historical gate establishes no independent alpha. Matched-risk momentum receives the identical correction for fair comparison.
invariants: Balanced attack and unchanged latched 8% alert; original NAV high-water mark never resets.
No feature, universe, label, model hyperparameter, calibrated forecast or transaction-fee change.
Known T+1, liquidity, cash and concentration limits stay in force; untradable positions are never treated as sold.
All old frozen inputs and accounts remain immutable.
Report failures and quality gaps; no APP, broker or WeChat actions.
